what: Alphabet is Google's parent: Google Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Gmail, Maps, Google Cloud and the Gemini AI models, plus long-term bets such as the Waymo self-driving business.
customers: Users get the services free; the paying customers are advertisers and companies using Google Cloud.
money: advertisers pay per click on search results
cloud infrastructure, AI and Workspace for companies
YouTube Premium, Google One, Pixel, Google Play
moat: About 90% of global search, enormous data, Android and Chrome as entry points, and one of the strongest AI teams with its own TPU chips.
risks: Search habits shifting to AI chatbots
Antitrust cases in the US and Europe
